About these listings

Current listings are curated from first-party sources. Passed deadlines, unreachable sources and overdue checks are removed from the current list.

02 / COVERAGE

Built around the
beginning of a legal career.

I

Training & graduate routes

Training contracts, trainee solicitor roles, vacation schemes, legal internships and graduate legal programmes.

II

Routes toward qualification

Paralegal and legal analyst roles where the listing indicates a clear path toward lawyer development.

III

Newly qualified & junior roles

NQ and junior associate opportunities, including roles seeking 0–2 years of post-qualification experience.

Saudi location is essential. Overseas roles, including Dubai, Abu Dhabi and London, are excluded. Inclusion does not mean every candidate qualifies.

Which firms does the monitor search for?

The monitor searches the complete 33-firm Riyadh target universe: A&O Shearman; Addleshaw Goddard; Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld; AS&H Clifford Chance; Baker Botts; Baker McKenzie; BCLP; Bird & Bird; Clyde & Co.; CMS; DLA Piper Legal Consultants; Eversheds Sutherland; Freshfields; Ghazzaawi Gowling WLG; Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher; Greenberg Traurig; Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer; Hogan Lovells; King & Spalding; Kirkland & Ellis; Latham & Watkins; Linklaters; Morgan Lewis; Norton Rose Fulbright; Pillsbury AlArfaj; Pinsent Masons; Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan; Reed Smith; Simmons & Simmons; Squire Patton Boggs; Stephenson Harwood; Trowers & Hamlins; and White & Case.

This is a search target list, not a claim that every firm has a current vacancy. Each role must independently meet the Saudi-location filter and be source-checked before it is shown.

What is shared, and who runs the alert?

Monitoring runs in the recipient’s own ChatGPT account. This independent page adds no account system, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. The hosting provider may process standard access logs.

A native shared task contains its title, instructions, schedule and original time zone. It does not include the creator’s chat history, earlier results or connected-app credentials. Each recipient controls their separate copy. Read OpenAI’s task-sharing guidance.
